summary: Comprehensive test suite with three-layer validation (unit tests, CLI integration, act end-to-end) covering all major requirements. All three retention policies are tested individually and in combination. Boundary conditions (exact age, timestamp ties, zero values) and error paths (invalid inputs, parse failures, deleter errors) are well-exercised. Fixture quality is good with helper functions and external data files. Minor weaknesses: auto-incrementing artifact ID counter in planner.test.ts creates fragility despite explicit overrides; a few extreme-value edge cases (MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, very large lists) are untested. The act harness validates exact output values, not just presence, which is excellent. Workflow structure validation is thorough. Would reliably catch regressions across the CLI, policies, and pipeline, but lacks perfect test isolation.
